available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing search by receptacle type (e.g., checking all drawers before cabinets) yields a shorter path to the target than strictly following the spatial listing order in the initial observation.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Type-based grouping followed by intra-group sequential traversal
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is hidden and multiple receptacle types are visible at entry.

available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing semantically relevant open surfaces (countertops, sink basins) before closed cabinets reduces search steps for toiletries compared to spatial listing order or generic type-grouping.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: Semantic priority scan: Open surfaces -> Closed storage
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld bathroom tasks where the target object is a toiletry (e.g., soap, toothpaste) and multiple closed storage receptacles are visible.

functional_contract.available_state: Initial room observation with multiple visible receptacles; target location unknown.
constraints: Must preserve the ability to acquire the target upon visibility.
Comparison must evaluate step efficiency relative to alternative initial probes.
functional_contract.local_function: Select and navigate to the first candidate receptacle for search.
functional_contract.required_downstream_state: Target object is visible at the selected receptacle.
